name: wyrd-scribe
description: wyrd-scribe — a tier-A MCP server for create-only provenance-stamped page writes.
//mutants: ⚠ USE `npm run mutate`. Do NOT hand-roll a mutation run that shells out to `npm test` — `test` runs `npm run build` first, which recompiles dist/ from src/ and ERASES a dist-patched mutant before the suite sees it, so every mutant SURVIVES and reads as a weak guard rather than as a dead instrument. Measured 2026-08-31. `scripts/mutate.mjs` is that rule as a mechanism: it builds once, drives the runner directly, asserts each anchor matches exactly once, and restores by hash.
//dependencies: ⚠ `wyrd-mcp` WAS HERE AND IS DELIBERATELY GONE, 2026-08-31. It was never imported by a line of code — it was declared so that the write path could reach `createFsGate` through the Reader, which is exactly the coupling the fence extraction removes. Two things make restoring it wrong rather than merely redundant: the fence is now `wyrd-fence`, and the Reader declares an empty `exports` map, so `import ... from 'wyrd-mcp'` no longer resolves to anything at all. A private, unpublished package must also not pin a PUBLISHED version of a sibling it does not use. ⚠ THE FENCE IS IMPORTED, NEVER REIMPLEMENTED (spec D8) — that rule is unchanged; only the package that satisfies it has.
